g.title: fisica_expo_03
g.text: Physical View 03 — Access, Persistence and Human Review
Proposed design · Blue: prototype · Gray: actors and external systems · Green: persistence
Solid: synchronous · Dashed: asynchronous · Dotted: event · Protocols in tooltips and guide
Actions retrieves the diagnosis through ACA native ingress and publishes its artifact. Human
review is within the diagnostic service.

a.xlink:title: technical_users | actor | L1 | status: confirmed
web_dashboard | container | L1 | status: confirmed
Queries results and records human review (HTTPS)
github | external_system | L8 | status: confirmed
Sends users to GitHub to authorize sign-in (OAuth 2.0/HTTPS (authorization code + PKCE S256))
pipeline_service | container | L5 | status: confirmed
Queries pipelines, executions, the incident queue and insights; registers workflows, grants access and changes incident state (REST/HTTPS)
log_event_service | container | L5 | status: confirmed
Queries logs, events and evidence (REST/HTTPS)
recommendation_service | container | L6 | status: confirmed | Grouped components: Human Review & Diagnostic Governance, Diagnostic API, Diagnostic Orchestrator, Diagnostic Output Composer
Reads diagnoses and records human reviews (REST/HTTPS)
github_actions | external_system | L8 | status: confirmed
Provides the repository, commits and CI/CD workflow definitions (GitHub API/HTTPS)
Queries diagnostic_output to publish the workflow artifact (REST/HTTPS)
postgresql_operational_store | datastore | L7 | status: confirmed
Persists pipelines, stages, states and execution metadata (PostgreSQL)
Checks committed operational membership before evidence registration (REST/HTTPS)
Persists and queries normalized evidence metadata and references (PostgreSQL)
Resolves the user's diagnosis read entitlement and the incident's ORIGIN execution (REST/HTTPS)
Projects the incident diagnosis summary into Pipeline's incident queue read model (REST/HTTPS)
Persists diagnoses with their recommendation and cited evidence (PostgreSQL)
Persists human review decisions and traceability (PostgreSQL)
